meta.description: The ORVIBO Smart Water Leak Sensor alerts your phone as soon as water reaches the floor, from a bathroom leak, a tap left open or rain through a window, so you can act before it does damage.
im_sec2.shadow_bg: Be the first to know when something happens at home
im_sec2.shadow:
You left the tap open during a water cut.
What if the water suddenly comes back?
im_sec2.shadow2:
On vacation when a leak starts at home.
How do you find out before it floods?
im_sec2.shadow3: A sudden downpour, and you can't get home to shut the windows?
im_sec2.shadow4:
Water pools on the bathroom floor, and kids and grandparents can slip.
What can you do?
im_sec3.f_p:
No mishap slips past it:
sensed at once, handled fast
im_sec3.s_p: Know right away about leaks, overflows and changes in the water level. With its high precision and sensitivity, anything that happens on the floor, a wall, a countertop or in any corner is found and dealt with in time, before it does more damage.
im_sec_5.tit: A split design that stands up to damp, even in the bathroom
im_sec_5.cont: Put the water leak sensor in the bathroom and it senses changes in the water level precisely and quickly. If the water rises too high, you get a notification right away, so you can clear the floor in time and keep kids and grandparents from slipping. And because the detector and its probe are separate parts, high humidity doesn't affect it.
im_sec_6.clearfix: Ultra-low power design, longer battery life
im_sec_6.clearfix3: Tool-free install: just put it down
